title: Inter natos mulierum (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Inter natos mulierum. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Tenor 2, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos1909); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
